root_cause.text: The RISC-V IOMMU driver implementation omitted the mandatory TLB and context cache invalidation sequence (`IOTINVAL`) following modifications to Device Directory Table (DDT) or Page Directory Table (PDT) entries, resulting in potential use of stale address translations.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states the fix performs invalidations "as mandated by the RISC-V IOMMU specification (Section 6.3.1 and 6.3.2)", and the patch diff shows the new `riscv_iommu_iodir_iotinval()` function being invoked within `riscv_iommu_iodir_update()` immediately after directory entry updates where it was previously absent.
